Write on water may be literary; the exhausted-memory simile does not prove an everyday fixed use.
Identical cultural-memory noun source repeats, while owner 406 tests uncovering a layer; generic concept needs owner-scope review before any alias.
Prior independent review found time-capsule lesson repeated selected 2726’s sound-triggered nostalgia decision.
Stitch it back together has no explicit referent; owner 1357 specifically restores social fabric.
The spotlight is shared does not assert the unequal sharing taught by owner 1478.
Good news with a spring in its step personifies news; owner 804 teaches an animate walker.
Back-and-forth between suspects could mean exchange or shifting suspicion; intended action remains ambiguous.
Tailored images or doubtful collocations need a stable shorter target and natural usage evidence.
